name: acs-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods, shared across local accounts.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A one-line forecast above the prompt: context fill and its trend, the 5-hour and weekly usage limits with where each is heading by its reset, and, at full width, how many sessions of the account are live.

plugins.name: next-steps-plus
plugins.description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts, informed by git state, the branch's PR and checks, and your notes. Hover or focus one to see its full prompt.
